Thanks — attaching the SOC2_Readiness_Summary.xlsx and a short FAQ. Key points:

- Retention: default 90 days for hosted, configurable for Dedicated/Private deployments; can extend per contract.
- KMS: integrates with AWS KMS/GCP KMS/HSM; customer-managed keys available for Private.

Attachment: SOC2_Readiness_Summary.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)
